## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `cd frontend && npm run build` passes (if UI changed)
- [ ] No new secrets committed (`.env` stays gitignored)
- [ ] Pydantic schemas remain strict (`extra="forbid"`)
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
